item.title: GUITAR HERO Spiritual Successor STAGE TOUR Lands METALLICA, MEGADETH, SLIPKNOT And More For 90-Song Soundtrack
item.description: Plastic guitars are crawling out of the closet again. Stage Tour, the new rhythm game from RedOctane Games, has locked in a December 10, 2026 release date and revealed a substantial portion of its launch soundtrack.
